practice: Lumora Health  - Health and wellness coaching
short: Lumora Health offers evidence-informed, client-centred health and wellness coaching to support individuals in building healthier, more balanced lifestyles. Using motivational interviewing and behaviour-change strategies, I support clients with nutrition, physical activity, sleep, stress management, and overall well-being. My approach focuses on small, meaningful steps that fit each person's needs, values, and everyday life.
certs:
- Health Coaching Alliance of Canada – Registered Health Coach (HCA-RHC™)
- Wellcoaches – Certified Health & Well-Being Coach
- MSc, Lifestyle Health Sciences & Coaching – University of North Texas Health Science Center
- Postgraduate Certificate in Health & Wellness Coaching – Humber Polytechnic
- Graduate Diploma in Recreation & Leisure Services – Humber Polytechnic
- Mental Health First Aid – Certified
- QPR (Question, Persuade, Refer) Suicide Prevention Training
- Yukon University – Management & Supervision Certificate
training: I hold a Master of Science in Lifestyle Health Sciences & Coaching from the University of North Texas Health Science Center, with specialized education in lifestyle medicine, health behaviour change, and evidence-informed coaching. I also completed postgraduate education in Health & Wellness Coaching at Humber Polytechnic, including Wellcoaches-based coach training, and a Graduate Diploma in Recreation & Leisure Services. My training emphasizes motivational interviewing, client-centred coaching, positive behaviour change, and supporting sustainable improvements in nutrition, physical activity, sleep, stress management, and overall well-being.
integrative: My formal training is in Lifestyle Health Sciences & Coaching, with an evidence-informed approach to lifestyle medicine and whole-person wellness. My education includes nutrition, physical activity, sleep, stress management, and behaviour change. I do not currently hold a separate certification in functional or integrative medicine, but I incorporate relevant lifestyle medicine principles into my health coaching practice.
pricing:
- 5-session package: $250 CAD + applicable taxes
- One 90-minute Wellness Discovery session
- Four weekly 30-minute coaching sessions
